name: MonarchCurrencySelect
title: CurrencySelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (a .sheet with a List and .searchable) over the active ISO 4217 codes, with names from Locale.localizedString(forCurrencyCode:) and narrow symbols from Decimal.FormatStyle.Currency with .presentation(.narrow)
summary: A searchable picker for an ISO 4217 currency, with names and symbols in the reader's language.
whenToUse: For a billing, payout or display currency, where the list is long and people search by name, code or symbol.
whenNotToUse: Not for entering an amount; use MonarchCurrencyInput. For two or three currencies, use a Picker with .pickerStyle(.segmented) or .menu.
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<String?>, prompt: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, currencies: [String]? = nil, priority: [String] = [], locale: Locale? = nil, display: MonarchCurrencySelectDisplay = .name, showsSymbol: Bool = true, isRequired: Bool = false, isClearable: Bool = true, labels: MonarchCurrencySelectLabels = MonarchCurrencySelectLabels())
enum MonarchCurrencySelectDisplay { case name, code, codeAndName }
struct MonarchCurrencySelectLabels { init(suggested: String? = nil, all: String? = nil, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels()) }

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen ISO 4217 code. Any case is read; the picker writes upper case.

options.name: prompt
options.description: Shown in the field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: currencies
options.description: Limits the list to these codes, such as what a payment provider supports. nil lists currencyCodes.

options.name: priority
options.description: Codes listed first under Suggested while nothing is typed.

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of names and symbols and the sort order. The environment's locale when nil.

options.name: display
options.description: What the field and each row's label show: the name (Euro), the code (EUR) or both (EUR · Euro). With a code, the name is the row's description.

options.name: showsSymbol
options.description: Shows the symbol after the code at the end of each row, when it differs from the code.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds Required to the hint.

options.name: isClearable
options.description: Shows a clear button in the field while a currency is chosen.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces Suggested, All currencies and the combobox strings; the combobox's empty text is built in as No currencies match.

states.name: empty
states.description: The field shows the prompt in the subtle text colour.

states.name: chosen
states.description: The field shows the currency's label in the chosen display and a clear button when clearing is on.

states.name: suggestions
states.description: With priority and nothing typed, the list has a Suggested section and a section with the rest.

states.name: searching
states.description: The suggestions are hidden; matches are listed with labels that start with the query first.

states.name: no match
states.description: The list reads No currencies match.

states.name: error
states.description: The field border and message use the danger colour, with an icon; the error is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Label, value and border use the disabled roles; the sheet does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's: the input background and border (danger with an error) and the default text colour. In the list, the code and symbol are a muted caption at the end of each row and the chosen row has an accent check mark. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Names come from Foundation and symbols from its currency format, so wording can differ from the web's Intl and from Android. The code list is bundled (the same active currencies as the web) instead of Locale.Currency.isoCurrencies, which also lists funds, metals, test codes and retired currencies. The web's display values name, code and code-name are .name, .code and .codeAndName. The list opens in a sheet, as every MonarchCombobox does.
accessibility: The field is a button labelled with the label, whose value is the chosen row's label or None.
The help text, the error (read as Error: ...) and Required are the field's hint; a new error is announced.
The chosen row has the selected trait and a check mark, not colour alone.
Rows and the field are at least 44 points high.
Each row is read with its label, the name when the label is a code, then the code and the symbol.
edgeCases: A selection that is not in currencies is still listed first, so its name shows in the field.
A currency whose symbol is its code shows the code once.
Search finds a currency by symbol ($ finds every dollar) and, in other languages, by its English name.
Symbols depend on the locale: the narrow symbol of CAD is $ in English.

examples.title: Suggested currencies first
examples.template:
MonarchCurrencySelect(
    {{label}},
    selection: $currency,
    prompt: {{placeholder}},
    helper: {{helper}},
    priority: [{{priority.0}}, {{priority.1}}, {{priority.2}}],
    locale: Locale(identifier: {{locale}})
)
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencySelect(
    "Reporting currency",
    selection: $currency,
    prompt: "Search name, code or symbol",
    helper: "Totals convert to EUR.",
    priority: ["EUR", "GBP", "USD"],
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en")
)

examples.title: Codes for a narrow field
examples.code:
MonarchCurrencySelect(
    "Currency",
    selection: $currency,
    currencies: ["USD", "EUR", "JPY"],
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en_US"),
    display: .codeAndName
)
